bio: Elise and Jurgen have transformed a charming cottage into a cosy living room-style restaurant, welcoming diners with genuine hospitality. The chef only serves a surprise menu, which he executes masterfully. Expect no gimmicks, but rather carefully crafted dishes with occasional influences from far-flung places. For instance, he combines pickled salmon with the earthy sweetness of beetroot and the umami of miso. Be sure to try the cheese board – a delicious way to discover the inspiration behind the restaurant's name....
